Service law: Back wages – Appellant was appointed as Staff Nurse with the respondent – Enquiry was held against her that she professed to belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category but she did not belong to SC found that she did not belong the SC community – Single judge of High Court upheld the decision of Tahasildar – Disciplinary Authority dismissed her service on the basis of decision of Tahasildar – Appellant appealed against the decision of Single Judge – Division bench
Decision Date : 23-02-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1575/2022 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
